_doc: Hand-curated list of canon races and tribes. Includes major civilisations (Humans, Fishmen, Giants), subspecies (Long-Arms, Long-Legs, Snakeneck), the legendary (Lunarians, Buccaneers), and mentioned-but-unseen (Dosundada). Each entry: name, traits, notable members, status, debut.

races.name: Humans
races.traits: The default sentient species — most of the world's population.

races.name: Fishmen
races.traits: Aquatic humanoids — superhuman strength on land, ten times stronger underwater. Sub-types: shark, octopus, ray, eel, etc.

races.name: Merfolk
races.traits: Half-human, half-fish — single tail (mermaids) splits into two legs at age 30.

races.name: Giants
races.traits: From Elbaph — average height ~12 metres. Lifespan 300+ years. Renowned warriors with strict honour code.

races.name: Dwarves
races.traits: Tontatta tribe of Green Bit / Dressrosa. Tiny but lift huge weights. Childlike and trusting.

races.name: Mink Tribe
races.traits: Furred humanoids of Zou. Born with Electro. Transform into Sulong form under a full moon. Many sub-species: dog, cat, wolf, monkey, etc.

races.name: Skypieans
races.traits: Sky-dwellers with small wings on their backs. Live on cloud islands above the Blue Sea.

races.name: Shandians
races.traits: Sky tribe descended from the original inhabitants of the lost city of Shandora. Have small wings and use distinctive Burn-Bazooka tech.

races.name: Birkans
races.traits: Sky tribe from Birka. Members include God Enel. Have small wings.

races.name: Long-Arm Tribe
races.traits: Two elbow joints per arm — extreme reach. Forms a competitive subculture with the Long-Leg tribe.

races.name: Long-Leg Tribe
races.traits: Two knee joints per leg — extreme height and reach. Charlotte family is partly Long-Leg through Linlin's heritage.

races.name: Snakeneck Tribe
races.traits: Long-necked humanoids of Dressrosa-region origin.

races.name: Three-Eyed Tribe
races.traits: Possess a true third eye. Said to be able to read All-Blue / Poneglyph script when fully awakened. Extremely rare.

races.name: Lunarians
races.traits: Wing-bearing race of fire-warriors. Inborn flame on the back, fire-breath, and an integument harder than steel. Once worshipped as gods. Hunted near to extinction by the World Government.

races.name: Buccaneers
races.traits: Race of giants known as the strongest of their kind. Said to have tremendous physical strength and innate connection to Joy Boy.

races.name: Cyborgs
races.traits: Humans modified by science (originally Vegapunk's research). Pacifista, Seraphim, and individual modifications like Franky.

rungs.traits: Humans rebuilt with machinery. Franky reconstructed himself after the accident at Water 7.
Humans modified by science (originally Vegapunk's research). Pacifista, Seraphim, and individual modifications like Franky.

races.name: Klabautermann
races.traits: Spirit of a well-loved ship. Visible only to those with deep nautical sense. The Going Merry's Klabautermann was the last to appear on-page.
members: Going Merry's Klabautermann (deceased with the ship)

races.name: Tenryubito (Celestial Dragons)
races.traits: Genetically pure 'Holy' descendants of the founding 19 kings of the World Government. Wear Tenryubito helmets to keep the 'commoner air' out. Above the law.

races.name: Dosundada (Mentioned)
races.traits: Race mentioned by Saint Saturn during the Egghead arc — referenced as one of the ancient peoples. Almost no canon detail yet; theorised to be precursors of giants.
members: No on-page members yet — name only

races.name: Numbers
races.traits: Failed ancient-giant clones produced by Vegapunk via the Mother Flame, sold to Kaidou. Intelligence varies; physical strength is monstrous.

rungs.traits: Nine oversized fighters in Kaidou's service. Their strength is monstrous; their intelligence varies.
Failed ancient-giant clones produced by Vegapunk via the Mother Flame, sold to Kaidou. Intelligence varies; physical strength is monstrous.

races.name: Homies
races.traits: Inanimate objects given a fragment of soul by Charlotte Linlin's Soru Soru no Mi. Range from clouds to weapons to entire islands.

_qa_flags: Three-Eyed Tribe: gate_chapter 86 derives from a member's debut and looks wrong — the tribe is not established that early. Members list also needs review: it includes Nico Olvia, who is not of the Three-Eye Tribe, plus two entries marked speculative. Left ungated-by-rung pending a maintainer call.
Tenryubito: deliberately NOT laddered. The entry's own name is the Ch. 497 reveal, so any earlier rung would leak in the title. Gate stays 497.
Cyborgs and Numbers lower rungs deliberately omit Vegapunk, Pacifista, Seraphim and the ancient-giant-clone origin, all of which are later reveals.
